This 2016 Bentley Continental GTC Speed W12 finished in Beluga over a Tan interior with only 13,445 miles represents the pinnacle of Bentley's previous generation grand touring convertibles, combining immense W12 power with handcrafted British luxury. Under the hood sits a 6.0 liter twin turbocharged W12 producing 633 horsepower and 620 lb ft of torque, paired to an 8 speed automatic transmission and Bentley's advanced all wheel drive system. This powertrain delivers effortless acceleration, allowing the GTC Speed to reach 0 to 60 mph in about 4.0 seconds while achieving a top speed of roughly 202 mph. Despite its robust construction and luxury convertible architecture, the platform maintains a curb weight of about 5,501 lbs, delivering impressive stability and high speed touring capability that has long defined Bentley's flagship performance models. Chassis engineering focuses on both dynamic capability and the refined comfort expected from a Bentley grand tourer. The Continental GTC Speed utilizes a fully independent suspension system with performance tuned dampers and stabilizer bars, allowing the car to balance confident handling with exceptional ride quality during long distance cruising. Massive ventilated performance brakes provide strong stopping power while the wide stance and all wheel drive traction ensure remarkable composure under acceleration. The power operated multi layer fabric convertible roof opens or closes in about 25 seconds and is heavily insulated to maintain coupe like quietness when raised. Inside, the cabin showcases Bentley's renowned craftsmanship with hand stitched leather upholstery, rich wood veneers, knurled metal controls, and deep power adjustable seating designed for long distance comfort. In this timeless Beluga over Tan specification with very low mileage, the 2016 Continental GTC Speed stands as a compelling example of Bentley's ability to combine immense W12 performance with open air luxury and unmistakable grand touring presence. Simply set the desired speed using the steering wheel mounted controls and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.

OVERVIEW
The 2022 McLaren 765LT is a no-compromise, no-nonsense supercar built for pure adrenaline. Inspired by McLaren's racing heritage and refined for street use, the 765LT takes the already brilliant 720S foundation and turns it into something far more focused, visceral, and unforgettable. Power comes from a ferocious 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8, tuned to produce 755 horsepower and 590 lb-ft of torque. Mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission, the 765LT launches from 0-60 mph in just 2.7 seconds and on to a top speed of 205 mph. The "LT" philosophy is built on one principle: less weight and more performance. Extensive use of carbon fiber, titanium hardware, lightweight glass, and track-focused components strips mass while increasing rigidity and response. The result: sharp turn-in, endless grip, and a level of balance that inspires confidence at the limit. Massive carbon-ceramic brakes deliver fade-free stopping power, while the active aero system adds real downforce for high-speed stability and cornering. Extended bodywork, a low stance, aggressive front aero, and signature Longtail rear design make the 765 instantly recognizable. Inside, the cabin is minimalist and built for the driver first. Lightweight sports seats, Alcantara, and extensive application of carbon fiber emphasize its track intent, while modern tech and performance telemetry keep the experience connected and immersive. In sum, the McLaren 765LT is a statement of engineering obsession. Rare, ferocious, and a true collectible, it stands out as one of the greatest modern Longtails ever built––a supercar designed and built to be remembered.

description: This is our 2023 Ferrari SF90 Spider finished in Giallo Triplo Strato with Tetto Nero DS over a Black Alcantara interior with yellow accents. The SF90 Spider is not simply a convertible Ferrari — it is the open-air evolution of the most technologically advanced road car ever produced by Ferrari. Powered by a 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8 paired with three electric motors, this plug-in hybrid powertrain delivers a staggering 986 horsepower and launches from 0–60 mph in approximately 2.5 seconds, with 0–124 mph arriving in just 6.7 seconds. Torque vectoring from the twin front electric motors provides all-wheel-drive precision, while the 8-speed dual-clutch transmission delivers instantaneous shifts. This is Formula 1-derived performance translated to the street. Finished in the extraordinary Giallo Triplo Strato, this is not a standard yellow. The triple-layer paint process gives the body an almost liquid depth — glowing in sunlight and radiating intensity under artificial light. Against the contrasting Tetto Nero DS (Gloss Black Roof), the lines of the Spider become sharper and more dramatic, emphasizing the sculpted flying buttresses and aerodynamic channels that define the SF90’s silhouette. Inside, the Black Alcantara cabin with yellow accents mirrors the exterior drama. description:
Porsche Marin is proud to present this beautifully specified Porsche 911 Targa 4S, a timeless sports car that blends open-air driving enjoyment with everyday usability and unmistakable Porsche performance. Finished in Black and paired with a Leather Interior in Black, this Targa 4S showcases a sophisticated configuration enhanced by striking Guards Red interior accents, creating a bold yet refined driving environment.

At its core, the Porsche flat-six engine delivers the unmistakable character Porsche is known for-sharp throttle response, exhilarating acceleration, and the distinctive soundtrack that defines the 911 experience. Enhancing its dynamic capabilities is the Sport Chrono Package, included as part of the Sport Package, allowing drivers to tailor performance with multiple drive modes and performance-focused calibration. The Sport Exhaust System with tailpipes in Black further amplifies the iconic Porsche sound.

This example is equipped with the Premium Package, adding sought-after features such as Power Folding Exterior Mirrors, Ambient Lighting, Ventilated Front Seats, Storage Package, and the immersive BOSE Surround Sound System. Advanced driver assistance technologies including Lane Change Assist (LCA) and Surround View provide additional confidence and convenience during everyday driving.

Visually, this Targa 4S is elevated by LED-Matrix Design Headlights in Black with Porsche Dynamic Light System Plus (PDLS+), the signature Targa Bar in Black, and 20"/21" Carrera Exclusive Design Wheels finished in Satin Black, giving the car a distinctive and purposeful presence. Power Steering Plus enhances maneuverability at lower speeds, improving comfort in urban driving environments.

Inside, the cabin reflects Porsches renowned craftsmanship and attention to detail. Adaptive Sport Seats Plus (18-way) with Memory Package provide exceptional support and adjustability, while performance-inspired accents including Seat Belts in Guards Red, a Central Tachometer in Guards Red, and a Sport Chrono Stopwatch Dial in Guards Red reinforce the cars sporting character. The interior is further enhanced with Matte Carbon Fiber Interior Trim Inlays, Porsche Crests on the Headrests, and Sport Seats Plus Backrest Shells in Leather with Painted Inlay.

A full Deviated Stitching Interior Package in Guards Red extends throughout the cabin, accenting the dashboard, rear side panels, door panels, knee pads, and center console lid, creating a cohesive and bespoke interior design. Completing the exterior are distinctive Clear Taillights, adding a modern finishing touch that complements the vehicles sleek design.

This exceptional Porsche 911 Targa 4S embodies the perfect balance of heritage styling, open-top enjoyment, and everyday performance.

For more information or to schedule a private consultation, please contact us at lcouncil@porschemarin.com or visit Porsche Marin.

Carbon fiber illuminated door-sill guards, a leather-wrapped steering column casing with deviated stitching, and the Door Trim Package in Leather/Race-Tex further underscore the bespoke craftsmanship.

With its high-revving naturally aspirated engine, Weissach weight-saving measures, and an extensively tailored interior, this 718 Spyder RS delivers a visceral, motorsport-inspired driving experience that stands among the most focused road cars Porsche has ever produced.

description: * Original MSRP of $209,315 * Daytona Seats * The Ferrari California (Type F149) is a grand touring, high performance sports car created by the Italian automobile manufacturer Ferrari. It is a two-door, 2+2 hard top convertible which is powered by a 4.3L naturally aspirated V8 engine which can produce 453hp at 7,750rpm and 358lb/ft of torque at 5,000rpm. The California had a top speed of 193 mph and could accelerate from 060mph in 3.9 seconds.The car revives the name used on the late-1950s Ferrari 250 GT California Spyder and the 1960s 365 California. When introduced in 2008, the modern California represented Ferraris entrance into a 4th model category, (front-engine, eight cylinder, grand tourer). The California represented a radical new design by Pininfarina S.p.A. and was developed under the oversight of Ken Okuyama. The car's grand touring personality was emphasized with a slightly higher ride height compared to its more aggressive siblings. The chassis was designed and manufactured by Ferrari division Carrozzeria Scaglietti. Overall, it is considered a landmark car for Ferrari in that it represents a number of concepts being used for the first time in their road cars. These being: The first front engine Ferrari with a V8, the first to feature a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission, the first hard top convertible with a folding metal roof, the first with multi-link rear suspension and the first with direct petrol injection. description: I was a sales manager at Palm Chevrolet in Punta Gorda when the F-Body Camaro had its final run, and even back then we couldn't understand why such an amazing car was being discontinued. Now we know that it was done simply to boost Corvette sales, but if one spec could have been ordered back then, the 35th Anniversary Z28/SS Convertible would have been it!In the autumn of 2002, as the last fourth-generation F-bodies trickled out of the Sainte-Th r se assembly plant, most were destined for a life of stoplight drag races and suburban driveways. But a select few were purchased for longevity and maintained in climate-controlled storage. This is one of those examples. With just over 3,500 miles on the odometer, this 35th Anniversary SS doesn t just represent the end of an era it s a living specimen of it.It comes to you with a perfect CarFAX and AutoCheck history as well. Take a moment to ready my description of the car and go through all 170 detailed photos. Feel free to call with questions. My cell is 941-286-0889 and I look forward to discussing the car with you.The Exterior:While the base Z28 was a formidable catfish car, the SS package (RPO WU8) added the necessary visual muscle. This anniversary edition wears its Bright Rally Red paint with a depth that suggests it hasn t seen a car wash brush since the Bush administration. The signature silver trophy stripes fade into checkered flags across the hood and decklid, leading your eye to the functional, forced-air induction scoop that defines the SS silhouette. I cannot find a stone chip, scuff, or mark to report, but I am sure if you spent days going over the car with a fine-tooth comb you might find some inconsequential blemish. I can't, and I tried to see one. Glass is flawless and original all the way around. Headlamps, marker lights, and tail lamps look like new. Anniversary decals are like new with no fade or lifting evident anywhere. The 17-inch ten-spoke aluminum wheels unique to this anniversary run feature blacked-out inserts and machined faces that remain free of a single millimeter of curb rash. Even the black anodized brake calipers behind them look as though they ve never felt the heat of a hard stop. Overall, it probably looks better today than it did sitting on the dealer's showroom in 2002 with all those salespersons handprints all over it!SS Performance/Appearance package:Installed by SLP for GM, this gives you the 325hp upgraded V8 with specific forced air induction hood, SS specific rear spoiler, high performance ride and handling suspension, low restriction dual outlet exhaust, and SS Badging.Other options:You also get the 35th Anniversary SPECIAL EDITION package, aforementioned 12-disc CD changer, and the limited slip rear differential. The car also comes with electronic cruise control, remote trunk release, power convertible top, fog lamps, power windows and door locks, leather wrapped steering wheel, remote keyless entry, theft deterrent alarm, and 6-way power driver seat too!The Interior:Open the door, and you re still greeted by that distinct new GM scent a mix of leather, high-grade plastics, and nostalgia. The Anniversary-exclusive two-tone leather seats (Ebony with Pewter inserts) show zero bolster wear, no rips, tears, stains, or seam pulls. The embroidered 35th Anniversary logos on the headrests are crisp and unfaded. Unlike most F-bodies of this vintage, there are no mystery rattles or cracked dash pads here. The Monsoon 500-watt premium audio system still houses its factory-correct 12-disc CD changer in the trunk, ready to play your favorite Y2K-era tracks. The CD Magazine has never even been outside of its plastic wrap from the factory! Every switch, from the power convertible top to the redundant steering wheel controls, operates with a new-car feel that only low-mileage survivors retain. I cannot imagine finding a cleaner interior elsewhere.The Mechanicals:Under the composite hood sits the LS1 V8, a 5.7-liter pushrod masterpiece detuned only slightly from its Corvette sibling to produce a factory-rated 325 horsepower. Because this example was ordered with the GU5 Performance Axle, it carries a 3.23 rear-end ratio that gives the 4-speed automatic transmission a noticeably sharper punch than the standard cruiser. Power delivery is seamless, aided by the Acceleration Slip Regulation (Traction Control) a vital box to check for a high-torque rear-driver. The undercarriage is factory-correct and original with visible paper tags and factory markings, and it has the High-Performance Ride and Handling Suspension that keeps those 275-series Goodyear Eagles planted. This isn't a restored car, it is a factory-original machine that has been preserved in a state of mechanical stasis. Tires are original to the car and are NOT recommended for highway driving due to the date code and manufacturer guides. They are NOT damaged and are left with the car for collector's value.The Extras:The original owner kept EVERYTHING with the car, and it comes to you with the following:-Full owner manual packet with every supplement it came with new-SS/SLP supplement pack with post its, tire gauge, pen, SLP booklet, SLP Keychain, SLP jacket pin, SLP jacket sew on.-Original window sticker laminated for protection-2002 Chevy Camaro model book-Original wheel lock with decals and code-Original SLP letter to owner-Two sets of GM original keys-Two original and functional FOB units-SLP leather trunk and fender mat-Original hard tonneau and tote bag in exceptional condition-Full size lined car cover with storage bagFinal thoughts:The 2002 SS was the Best of the Last. In a world of increasingly digital sports cars, this analog, pushrod-powered brute offers a visceral connection to the pavement that is rapidly disappearing. For the collector who demands perfection, this isn't just a Camaro it's a 3,500-mile invitation to go back to 2002 and do it all over again. Call JJ direct at 941-286-0889 for an appointment to see it, or to schedule a FaceTime walk-around or virtual test drive.

2018 Ford Mustang EcoBoost Premium: The Intelligent Athlete

The 2018 Ford Mustang EcoBoost Premium represents a masterclass in modern muscle. While many associate the Mustang with raw, vintage power, this specific model year introduced a level of refinement, technology, and balanced performance that makes it a sophisticated choice for the modern enthusiast.

The Power of Innovation

At the heart of the 2018 EcoBoost is the 2.3-liter turbocharged I-4 engine, delivering a punchy 310 horsepower and a massive 350 lb-ft of torque.

Turbocharged Response: Thanks to its high torque output at low RPMs, the EcoBoost feels incredibly snappy off the line. It provides a surge of acceleration that makes merging and overtaking effortless.

The 10-Speed Advantage: The 2018 model features the lightning-fast 10-speed automatic transmission. This gearbox keeps the engine perfectly in its power band, offering crisp, nearly imperceptible shifts that enhance both performance and highway smoothness.

Agile and Lightweight

One of the greatest advantages of the EcoBoost is its lighter front end. Without the weight of a heavy V8 over the front wheels, the steering is remarkably sharp and precise.

Balanced Handling: The car feels nimble and eager to dive into corners. The independent rear suspension, refined for the 2018 refresh, ensures the car stays planted and composed even on undulating roads.

Versatility: With selectable drive modes (Normal, Sport+, Track, and Snow/Wet), the Mustang adapts its personality to suit your mood or the environment at the flick of a toggle.

Premium Interior & Tech

The Premium trim elevates the Mustang from a sports car to a luxury grand tourer.

Luxurious Cabin: Inside, you are greeted by heated and cooled leather-trimmed seats that offer exceptional comfort for long-distance cruising. The soft-touch materials and ambient lighting create a high-end atmosphere.

Next-Gen Connectivity: The SYNC 3 infotainment system is a standout, featuring a crisp 8-inch touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration. It is intuitive, fast, and puts everything from navigation to climate control at your fingertips.

Digital Cockpit: The 2018 model also introduced the stunning, customizable 12-inch digital instrument cluster, which provides a futuristic and high-tech feel every time you start the engine.

Iconic Presence

Visually, the 2018 refresh brought a leaner, meaner look. The lowered hood, restyled LED headlamps, and aggressive front fascia give it a predatory stance that honors its heritage while looking firmly toward the future.

Verdict

The 2018 Ford Mustang EcoBoost Premium is the perfect blend of style, agility, and modern luxury. It proves that you can have all the iconic Mustang soul with a smarter, more efficient, and highly tech-forward heart. It is, quite simply, a joy to drive every single day.
